description: Na₃GaS₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Ga and five S atoms. The Na-Ga bond length is 3.06 Å. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.77-3.21 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.75-2.96 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.85-2.91 Å. Ga is bonded to one Na and four S atoms to form distorted edge-sharing GaNaS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ga-S bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.35 Å. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Ga atom. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Ga atoms. In the third S site, S is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Ga atom.
